allowed: immutable recorded-data segments plus run specification and run-local baseline snapshot from a completed yadof benchmark run
a tracked immutable history snapshot selected by exact identity in benchmark.toml
another immutable recorded-evidence export with equivalent task-snapshot, segment, row, and source hashes
required_per_source: run ID and suite/arm/seed when applicable
task snapshot ID and interpretation/evaluation fingerprints
recording segment membership and SHA-256 digests
attempted, decoded, compatible, invalid, failed, duplicate, and retained unique-design counts
proof that formal test campaigns and their seeds are absent
forbidden: baseline.json smoke shape or smoke cost entries as design rows
mutable baseline templates or mutable workspace records without an immutable snapshot
README or verification-summary aggregate numbers without the underlying recorded rawData
predicted rawData, surrogate samples, costs without rawData, or postprocessed plots
formal optimization-test outcomes reused for training, validation, calibration, or threshold selection

documented_generated_runs.note: The benchmark README contains historical summaries, but the current checkout's configured temp root has no inspectable run_spec.json/run_state.json for these named runs. Summary prose is not rawData evidence.

minimum_future_dataset.duplicate_design_policy: Group exact canonical normalized-variable duplicates by design ID, retain one deterministic real record for primary metrics, keep repeat counts as diagnostics, and never split a duplicate group across partitions.
minimum_future_dataset.invalid_row_policy: Exclude a complete row before splitting when raw variables, selector set, main shape/dtype, exact axes, required metadata, schema validation, or current-cost interpretation is incompatible; report every exclusion category and stop if fewer than 2800 unique rows remain.

authorization_boundary.candidate_future_source: A separately authorized complete, unfiltered performance-data run may supply real rows, but it must receive a new immutable run ID and sealed source manifest. The current performance plan is 100 individuals x 20 generations in six cells (12000 attempted evaluations total) and is not launched by Gate 0.
authorization_boundary.blocking_gap: No legal 1000/2000-training-design frozen evidence is presently available in this checkout. Gate 1 protocol/fake tests may proceed; data-dependent fitting, calibration, threshold sealing, and formal performance claims may not.
